articles.title: NSE IPO buzz lifts New India Assurance, IFCI up to 9% | What do technical experts say?
articles.snippet: New India Assurance's shares rose 9.4% and IFCI's by 7.8% amid the NSE IPO. Both stocks experienced volatility, influenced by market developments. Technical analysts suggest potential support and resistance levels, indicating ongoing fluctuations in their trends.

articles.title: NSE IPO: Issue subscribed 42% on Day 1; GMP signals 9% listing gain. Should you subscribe?
articles.snippet: The NSE IPO was subscribed 42% on Day 1, with investors bidding for 3.7 crore shares against 8.86 crore shares on offer. Non-institutional investors led with 70% subscription, followed by retail investors at 43% and QIBs at 19%. Meanwhile, the IPO’s grey market premium hovered around 9%, suggesting expectations of a moderate listing gain.
